requirements_summary: Workload: customer-facing KB search and support assistant. Index scale: ~20M documents (~200GB embeddings storage estimate). QPS requirements: sustained 500+ qps, peaks up to 1.5-2k qps. Latency: target 50-120ms end-to-end for search+rerank on top-k (k=10) with p95/p99 targets. Cost sensitivity: target cost-per-query <$0.01 (aiming for <$0.005 with batching/caching). Model preference: open-model embeddings (1536d) + cross-encoder reranker for top 100 candidates. Routing: region-aware (NA + EU) with fallbacks. Security: SOC2, SSO, audit logs, KMS-managed keys.
poc_summary:
POC setup: hosted API, ingest pipeline using Redwood SDK, ANN index via provider, cross-encoder rerank on hosted endpoints. Results so far:
- Embedding indexing time: ~7 hours for 20M docs on sample dataset (initial run).
- Baseline latency (hosted naive): 220ms median for search+rerank at low load.
- Optimized config draft: continuous batching + prefix cache reduced median to ~85ms in lab for 500 qps.
- Cost estimate (hosted): projected $0.006 - $0.009 per query at 500 qps depending on rerank model size.
Outstanding: repeatable benchmark at sustained 1k+ qps, clarify tokenization accounting for cost model.
sla_targets: p95 < 200ms for search+rerank during normal hours; p99 < 350ms; availability 99.9% for prod tier
routing_needs: region-aware routing (na primary, eu secondary), automatic fallback to smaller reranker if high latency detected
cost_constraints: budget-owner wants worst-case TCO < $80k/year in Y1 for hosted API (but willing to scale to 100-250k if SLA proven)
onboarding_risks:
- ingest throughput surprises (longer than estimated).
- complexity of rerank integration.
- legal DPA/data residency delays.
integration_notes: Using S3 snapshot for ingest; CI pipeline triggers for incremental syncs. Currently evaluating Redwood Optimize suggestions: 8-bit quantization for rerank model and 2-tier caching. SE (Priya) to propose autoscale settings.
notes_short: evaluation-stage POC focused on hosted embeddings + rerank; high QPS; wants clear cost/latency tradeoffs; SOC2+DPA required.
